name: Side Plank Dip
steps: Set up in a forearm side plank with your elbow beneath your shoulder, feet stacked, and hips lifted in a straight line.
Keep your chest facing forward and lower your bottom hip smoothly down until it lightly taps the floor.
Contract your lower oblique strongly to drive your hips back up slightly past neutral alignment.
Lower with control into the next repetition, and switch sides after completing one side.
tips: Keep your shoulders and hips stacked vertically instead of rolling forward toward the floor.
Press actively through your forearm to keep your supporting shoulder stable away from your ear.
